rationale: The stock is trading at 70% of today's wide range ($76.63–$81.50) with the last five 1-minute candles showing a clear deceleration and slight drift lower from $80.39 to $80.00, suggesting momentum is fading near the upper portion of the range. The recent public offering priced at $75/share (a ~6.4% discount to current price) creates a meaningful overhead supply ceiling and dilution overhang that argues against a long, while the 11.9x relative volume and already-elevated price above the offering price make a short risky without a clear breakdown catalyst. The conflicting signals — strong capital raise news vs. dilution pressure vs. fading intraday momentum — do not present a clean directional edge.
